message.content: Use the Agent tool exactly once, in the foreground (do not run it in the background), with subagent_type general-purpose and description 'chain'. Its prompt: 'Read f1.txt with the Read tool. Each file names the next file to read; read exactly one file per tool call, in order, through f15.txt. Never read two files in one turn. Between reads, if the coordinator sent you a message, follow it. Finally reply with the content of each file and quote any coordinator message you received.' After it returns, reply DONE.

COORD-PING: when you read your next file, also say the word PONG in your final reply.
